المحاضرة 5 · ورقة مراجعة

الفصل 5: HTML 2 — الجداول والنماذج

الجداول تعرض البيانات والنماذج تجمعها: كل تسجيل دخول وبحث وشراء يمر من هنا.

01 نظرة عامة

ما موضوع المحاضرة؟

الفصل 5 من Connolly & Hoar: HTML 2: الجداول والنماذج. بناء الجداول (tr، td، th، colspan/rowspan، caption، thead/tbody/tfoot)، تنسيقها بـ CSS (الحدود، الصناديق، الحمار الوحشي)، النماذج وكيف تعمل (action، method، GET وPOST، سلسلة الاستعلام)، عناصر التحكم (نص، اختيار، أزرار، ملفات، أرقام، ألوان، تواريخ)، الإتاحة (WAI، scope، label for)، تنسيق وتصميم النماذج، والتحقق من المدخلات.

Chapter 5 of Connolly & Hoar: HTML 2: Tables and Forms. Building tables (tr, td, th, colspan/rowspan, caption, thead/tbody/tfoot), styling them with CSS (borders, boxes, zebras), forms and how they work (action, method, GET vs POST, query strings), the controls (text, choice, buttons, file, number, colour, dates), accessibility (WAI, scope, label for), form styling and design, and input validation.

الفكرة الأساسية

الجدول يعرض بيانات في شبكة؛ النموذج يجمع بيانات ويرسلها للخادم كأزواج name=value عبر GET (في الرابط) أو POST (في جسم الطلب). ولا تثق بالمدخلات: تحقق دائمًا على الخادم.

A table shows data in a grid; a form collects data and sends it to the server as name=value pairs via GET (in the URL) or POST (in the body). Never trust input: always validate on the server.

قائمة المفاهيم الأساسية

  • بنية الجدول (3–7)
  • الجداول للتخطيط (8)
  • تنسيق الجداول (9–12)
  • عمل النماذج وسلسلة الاستعلام (13–16)
  • form وGET/POST (17–20)
  • عناصر التحكم (21–34)
  • الإتاحة (35–38)
  • تنسيق وتصميم النماذج (39–41)
  • التحقق (42–47)
  • Table structure (3–7)
  • Tables for layout (8)
  • Styling tables (9–12)
  • How forms work, query strings (13–16)
  • form and GET/POST (17–20)
  • Form controls (21–34)
  • Accessibility (35–38)
  • Form styling and design (39–41)
  • Validation (42–47)

المهارات المكتسبة

  • بناء جدول صحيح مع عناوين ودمج خلايا.
  • تنسيق جدول بالحدود وتلوين الصفوف.
  • بناء نموذج وتوقع سلسلة الاستعلام الناتجة.
  • اختيار GET أو POST وعنصر التحكم المناسب.
  • جعل الجداول والنماذج متاحة.
  • تخطيط التحقق في ثلاثة مستويات.
  • Build a correct table with headings and merged cells.
  • Style a table with borders and striping.
  • Build a form and predict its query string.
  • Choose GET or POST and the right control.
  • Make tables and forms accessible.
  • Plan validation at three levels.

لماذا يهم؟

كل تسجيل دخول، بحث، شراء، أو تسجيل يمر عبر نموذج؛ وكل ثغرة حقن تبدأ بمدخل لم يُتحقق منه.

Every login, search, purchase or sign-up goes through a form; and every injection flaw starts with unvalidated input.

الشريحة 03 — HTML Tables

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A table in HTML is created using the <table> element and can be used to represent information that exists in a two-dimensional grid.
  • Just like a real-world table, an HTML table can contain any type of data: not just numbers, but text, images, forms, even other tables
  • <table> contains any number of rows (<tr>); each row contains any number of table data cells (<td>)

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A table in HTML is created using the <table> element and can be used to represent information that exists in a two-dimensional grid.

    الجدول يُنشأ بـ <table> ويمثل بيانات في شبكة ثنائية الأبعاد.

    A table is made with <table> and shows data in a 2-D grid.

  2. Just like a real-world table, an HTML table can contain any type of data: not just numbers, but text, images, forms, even other tables

    الخلية تحتوي أي شيء: نص، صور، نماذج، حتى جداول.

    A cell can hold anything: text, images, forms, even tables.

  3. <table> contains any number of rows (<tr>); each row contains any number of table data cells (<td>)

    <table> ← صفوف <tr> ← خلايا <td>.

    <table> → rows <tr> → cells <td>.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لاحظ: لا يوجد عنصر «عمود» تكتبه؛ الأعمدة تنشأ من ترتيب الخلايا داخل كل صف.

Note: there is no column element you write; columns come from the order of cells in each row.

الخلاصة

table ← tr ← td.
table → tr → td.

الشريحة 04 — Basic table structure

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<table>
   <tr>
      <td>The Death of Marat</td>
      <td>Jacques-Louis David</td>
      <td>1793</td>
      <td>162cm</td>
      <td>128cm</td>
   </tr>
   <tr>
      <td>Burial at Ornans</td>
      <td>Gustave Courbet</td>
      <td>1849</td>
      <td>314cm</td>
      <td>663cm</td>
   </tr>
</table>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A two-row table of paintings with each <tr> and <td> labelled, its markup, and the browser result

    جدول من صفين مع تسمية كل tr وtd والنتيجة في المتصفح.

    A two-row table with each tr and td labelled, and the browser result.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

بدون CSS يظهر الجدول بلا حدود، فقط نص مصفوف (كما في لقطة المتصفح).

Without CSS the table shows no borders, just aligned text (as in the browser screenshot).

الخلاصة

صفان × 5 خلايا.
2 rows × 5 cells.

الشريحة 05 — Spanning Rows and Columns

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • All content must appear within the <td> or <th> container.
  • Each row must have the same number of <td> or <th> containers.
  • If you want a given cell to cover several columns or rows, then you can do so by using the colspan or rowspan attributes

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. All content must appear within the <td> or <th> container.

    كل المحتوى داخل <td> أو <th>.

    All content goes inside <td> or <th>.

  2. Each row must have the same number of <td> or <th> containers.

    كل صف بنفس عدد الخلايا.

    Every row has the same number of cells.

  3. If you want a given cell to cover several columns or rows, then you can do so by using the colspan or rowspan attributes

    لدمج الخلايا: colspan (أعمدة) و rowspan (صفوف).

    To merge cells: colspan (columns) and rowspan (rows).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الخلية ذات colspan="2" تُحسب خليتين؛ لذلك صف العناوين في الشريحة 6 فيه 4 عناصر فقط لكنه يغطي 5 أعمدة.

A cell with colspan="2" counts as two; so slide 6's header row has only 4 elements yet covers 5 columns.

الخلاصة

colspan / rowspan.
colspan / rowspan.

الشريحة 06 — Adding Table Headings and Spanning columns

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<table>
   <tr>
      <th>Title</th>
      <th>Artist</th>
      <th>Year</th>
      <th colspan="2">Size (width x height)</th>
   </tr>
   <tr>
      <td>The Death of Marat</td>
      <td>Jacques-Louis David</td>
      <td>1793</td>
      <td>162cm</td>
      <td>128cm</td>
   </tr>
   ...
</table>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A header row of <th> cells, with “Size (width x height)” spanning two columns — “Notice that this row now only has four cell elements.”

    صف عناوين <th>، و«Size» يمتد على عمودين؛ الصف فيه 4 عناصر فقط.

    A <th> header row; “Size” spans two columns, so the row has only four elements.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

<th> خلية عنوان: تظهر عريضة ومتوسطة افتراضيًا وتعطي معنى للبيانات.

<th> is a heading cell: bold and centred by default, and gives the data meaning.

الخلاصة

th + colspan.
th + colspan.

الشريحة 07 — Additional table elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<table>
   <caption>19th Century French Paintings</caption>      (1)
   <col class="artistName" />                             (2)
   <colgroup id="paintingColumns">                        (3)
      <col />
      <col />
   </colgroup>
   <thead>                                                (4)
      <tr>
         <th>Title</th>
         <th>Artist</th>
         <th>Year</th>
      </tr>
   </thead>
   <tfoot>                                                (5)
      <tr>
         <td colspan="2">Total Number of Paintings</td>
         <td>2</td>
      </tr>
   </tfoot>
   <tbody>                                                (6)
      <tr>
         <td>The Death of Marat</td>
         <td>Jacques-Louis David</td>
         <td>1793</td>
      </tr>
      <tr>
         <td>Burial at Ornans</td>
         <td>Gustave Courbet</td>
         <td>1849</td>
      </tr>
   </tbody>
</table>
  • (1) A title for the table is good for accessibility.
  • (2–3) These describe our columns and can be used to aid in styling.
  • (4) Table header could potentially also include other <tr> elements.
  • (5) Yes, the table footer comes before the body.
  • (6) Potentially, with styling, the browser can scroll this information while keeping the header and footer fixed in place.

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) <caption>, <col>, <colgroup>, <thead>, <tfoot> and <tbody> in one table, numbered 1–6 with notes

    caption وcol وcolgroup وthead وtfoot وtbody مرقمة 1–6.

    caption, col, colgroup, thead, tfoot and tbody, numbered 1–6.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

المتصفح يعرض tfoot في الأسفل حتى لو كُتب قبل tbody. (في HTML5 يُسمح بكتابة tfoot بعد tbody أيضًا.)

The browser shows tfoot at the bottom even if written before tbody. (HTML5 also allows writing tfoot after tbody.)

الخلاصة

6 عناصر إضافية.
6 extra elements.

الشريحة 08 — Using Tables for Layout

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Prior to the broad support for CSS in browsers, HTML tables were frequently used to create page layouts . Unfortunately, this practice of using tables for layout had some problems:
  • This approach tended to increase the size of the HTML document
  • The resulting markup is not semantic. Using <table> simply to get two block elements side by side is an example of using markup simply for presentation reasons
  • Using tables for layout results in a page that is not accessible (table-based layouts can be extremely uncomfortable and confusing to understand by screen readers)
  • The next chapter will examine how to use CSS for layout purposes.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Prior to the broad support for CSS in browsers, HTML tables were frequently used to create page layouts. Unfortunately, this practice of using tables for layout had some problems:

    قبل CSS كانت الجداول تُستخدم لتخطيط الصفحات، ولهذا مشاكل:

    Before CSS, tables were used for page layout, which had problems:

  2. This approach tended to increase the size of the HTML document

    يكبر حجم ملف HTML.

    Bigger HTML files.

  3. The resulting markup is not semantic. Using <table> simply to get two block elements side by side is an example of using markup simply for presentation reasons

    غير دلالي: الجدول للعرض فقط لا للمعنى.

    Not semantic: the table is just for looks.

  4. Using tables for layout results in a page that is not accessible (table-based layouts can be extremely uncomfortable and confusing to understand by screen readers)

    غير متاح: قارئ الشاشة يرتبك.

    Not accessible: screen readers get confused.

  5. The next chapter will examine how to use CSS for layout purposes.

    الفصل التالي: التخطيط بـ CSS.

    Next chapter: layout with CSS.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

القاعدة: الجدول للبيانات الجدولية فقط.

The rule: tables are only for tabular data.

الخلاصة

3 مشاكل: حجم، دلالة، إتاحة.
3 problems: size, semantics, accessibility.

الشريحة 09 — Styling Tables (Borders)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Borders can be assigned to both the <table> and the <td> element. Interestingly, borders cannot be assigned to the <tr>, <thead>, <tfoot>, and <tbody> elements.
  • Notice as well the border-collapse property. This property selects the table’s border model.
  • The default is the separated model or value (each cell has its own unique borders)
  • The collapsed border model makes adjacent cells share a single border.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Borders can be assigned to both the <table> and the <td> element. Interestingly, borders cannot be assigned to the <tr>, <thead>, <tfoot>, and <tbody> elements.

    الحدود على <table> و<td> فقط، لا على tr وthead وtfoot وtbody.

    Borders go on <table> and <td> only, not tr/thead/tfoot/tbody.

  2. Notice as well the border-collapse property. This property selects the table’s border model.

    border-collapse يختار نموذج الحدود.

    border-collapse picks the border model.

  3. The default is the separated model or value (each cell has its own unique borders)

    الافتراضي separate: لكل خلية حدودها.

    Default separate: each cell has its own border.

  4. The collapsed border model makes adjacent cells share a single border.

    collapse: الخلايا المتجاورة تتشارك حدًا واحدًا.

    collapse: adjacent cells share one border.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

تفصيل: في نموذج collapse يمكن أن تظهر حدود tr، لكن الشريحة تقدم القاعدة العامة كما هي.

Detail: under collapse, tr borders can show, but the slide states the general rule as printed.

الخلاصة

separate (افتراضي) / collapse.
separate (default) / collapse.

الشريحة 10 — Styling table borders

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

/* 1 */ table { border: solid 1pt black; }
/* 2 */ table { border: solid 1pt black; }
        td    { border: solid 1pt black; }
/* 3 */ table { border: solid 1pt black; border-collapse: collapse; }
        td    { border: solid 1pt black; }
/* 4 */ table { border: solid 1pt black; border-collapse: collapse; }
        td    { border: solid 1pt black; padding: 10pt; }
/* 5 */ table { border: solid 1pt black; border-spacing: 10pt; }
        td    { border: solid 1pt black; }

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) Five versions of the same table with different border CSS: table only, table + td, border-collapse, padding, border-spacing

    خمس نسخ: حد الجدول فقط، الجدول والخلايا، collapse، padding، border-spacing.

    Five versions: table border only, table + td, collapse, padding, border-spacing.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

border-spacing يعمل فقط في النموذج المنفصل (separate) ويحدد المسافة بين حدود الخلايا.

border-spacing only works in the separate model and sets the gap between cell borders.

الخلاصة

جرب الخمسة.
Try all five.

الشريحة 11 — Boxes and Zebras (i)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • While there is almost no end to the different ways one can style a table, there are a number of common approaches. We will look at two of them here.
  • The first of these is a box format, in which we simply apply background colors and borders in various ways

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

caption {
   font-weight: bold;
   padding: 0.25em 0 0.25em 0;
   text-align: left;
   text-transform: uppercase;
   border-top: 1px solid #DCA806;
}
table {
   font-size: 0.8em;
   font-family: Arial, sans-serif;
   border-collapse: collapse;
   border-top: 4px solid #DCA806;
   border-bottom: 1px solid white;
   text-align: left;
}
thead tr { background-color: #CACACA; }
th { padding: 0.75em; }
tbody tr {
   background-color: #F1F1F1;
   border-bottom: 1px solid white;
   color: #6E6E6E;
}
tbody td { padding: 0.75em; }

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. While there is almost no end to the different ways one can style a table, there are a number of common approaches. We will look at two of them here.

    طرق تنسيق الجداول كثيرة؛ نرى اثنتين.

    Many ways to style tables; we see two.

  2. The first of these is a box format, in which we simply apply background colors and borders in various ways

    الأولى: الصناديق، خلفيات وحدود.

    First: the box format, backgrounds and borders.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل يبني التنسيق في ثلاث خطوات: caption وtable، ثم thead، ثم tbody.

The figure builds it in three steps: caption and table, then thead, then tbody.

الخلاصة

Box = خلفيات + حدود.
Box = backgrounds + borders.

الشريحة 12 — Boxes and Zebras (ii)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • We can then
  • add special styling to the :hover pseudo-class of the <tr> element to highlight a row when the mouse cursor hovers over
  • use the pseudo-element nth-child (covered in Chapter 4) to alternate the format of every second row.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

tbody tr:hover {
   background-color: #9e9e9e;
   color: black;
}
tbody tr:nth-child(even) {
   background-color: lightgray;
}

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. We can then add special styling to the :hover pseudo-class of the <tr> element to highlight a row when the mouse cursor hovers over

    :hover على tr لإبراز الصف تحت المؤشر.

    :hover on tr highlights the row under the cursor.

  2. use the pseudo-element nth-child (covered in Chapter 4) to alternate the format of every second row.

    nth-child لتلوين كل صف ثانٍ (حمار وحشي).

    nth-child to shade every second row (zebra).

الشرح — شرح موسّع

ملاحظة: nth-child في الحقيقة pseudo-class لا pseudo-element (كما في جدول 4.5 بالفصل 4)؛ النص كما هو مطبوع.

Note: nth-child is really a pseudo-class, not a pseudo-element (as in Chapter 4's Table 4.5); text kept as printed.

الخلاصة

tr:hover + tr:nth-child(even).
tr:hover + tr:nth-child(even).

الشريحة 13 — Introducing Forms

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Up to now, clicking hyperlinks was the only mechanism available to the user
  • Forms provide the user with an alternative way to interact with a web server.
  • Using a form, the user can enter text, choose items from lists, and click buttons
  • Typically, programs running on the server will take the input from HTML forms and do something with it,
    • such as save it in a database,
    • interact with an external web service, or
    • customize subsequent HTML based on that input.
  • HTML5 has added a number of new controls and more customization options

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Up to now, clicking hyperlinks was the only mechanism available to the user

    حتى الآن: الروابط فقط.

    Until now: only links.

  2. Forms provide the user with an alternative way to interact with a web server.

    النماذج طريقة أخرى للتفاعل مع الخادم.

    Forms are another way to talk to the server.

  3. Using a form, the user can enter text, choose items from lists, and click buttons

    إدخال نص، اختيار من قوائم، ضغط أزرار.

    Enter text, choose from lists, click buttons.

  4. Typically, programs running on the server will take the input from HTML forms and do something with it, such as save it in a database, interact with an external web service, or customize subsequent HTML based on that input.

    برامج الخادم تحفظ في قاعدة بيانات، أو تتصل بخدمة، أو تخصص الصفحة التالية.

    Server programs save to a database, call a web service, or customise the next page.

  5. HTML5 has added a number of new controls and more customization options

    HTML5 أضاف عناصر جديدة.

    HTML5 added new controls.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

النموذج في المتصفح مجرد واجهة؛ المعالجة الحقيقية على الخادم (PHP لاحقًا في الكتاب).

The form in the browser is only the interface; the real processing is on the server (PHP later in the book).

الخلاصة

النموذج = إرسال بيانات للخادم.
Form = send data to the server.

الشريحة 14 — Form Structure

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<form method="post" action="process.php">
   <fieldset>
      <legend>Details</legend>
      <p>
         <label>Title: </label>
         <input type="text" name="title" />
      </p>
      <p>
         <label>Country: </label>
         <select name="where">
            <option>Choose a country</option>
            <option>Canada</option>
            <option>Finland</option>
            <option>United States</option>
         </select>
      </p>
      <input type="submit" />
   </fieldset>
</form>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) A form with fieldset, legend, labels, a text input, a select list and a submit button, mapped to the browser rendering

    نموذج: fieldset، legend، label، input، select، submit مع ربطها بالعرض.

    A form: fieldset, legend, label, input, select, submit, mapped to the rendering.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

name هو المفتاح الذي يصل للخادم (title و where)، وaction هو البرنامج المستقبل (process.php).

name is the key that reaches the server (title and where), and action is the receiving program (process.php).

الخلاصة

form ← fieldset ← عناصر.
form → fieldset → controls.

الشريحة 15 — How Forms Work

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (diagram) 1 A request is made. 2 Requested HTML contains form elements. 3 User fills in and submits form. 4 The user’s form data is sent to the server as part of the HTTP request. 5 This request is usually for some type of server-side script that will process the form data.

    5 خطوات: طلب، HTML فيه نموذج، المستخدم يملأ ويرسل، البيانات ترسل مع طلب HTTP، سكربت على الخادم يعالجها.

    5 steps: request, HTML with a form, user fills and submits, data sent with an HTTP request, a server script processes it.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لاحظ أن هناك طلبين: الأول يجلب الصفحة الفارغة، والثاني يحمل البيانات.

Note there are two requests: the first fetches the empty page, the second carries the data.

الخلاصة

طلبان: جلب ثم إرسال.
Two requests: fetch, then submit.

الشريحة 16 — Query Strings

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The browser “sends” the data to the server via an HTTP request using a query string.
  • A query string is a series of name=value pairs separated by ampersands (the & character).
  • Special symbols must be URL encoded

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<input type="text" name="title" /> and <input type="text" name="where" /> with values Central Park / United States →

title=Central+Park&where=United+States

“Notice how the spaces and the accented é are URL encoded (in red).” Artist: Pablo José Picasso →

artist=Pablo+Jos%E9+Picasso

[The slide's last line “Special symbols must be URL encoded” is partly hidden behind the figure.]

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The browser “sends” the data to the server via an HTTP request using a query string.

    البيانات تُرسل بسلسلة استعلام (query string).

    Data is sent as a query string.

  2. A query string is a series of name=value pairs separated by ampersands (the & character).

    أزواج name=value مفصولة بـ &.

    name=value pairs separated by &.

  3. Special symbols must be URL encoded

    الرموز الخاصة تُرمز (URL encoding).

    Special symbols are URL encoded.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

المثال: title=Central+Park&where=United+States، المسافة تصبح + و é تصبح %E9: artist=Pablo+Jos%E9+Picasso.

Example: title=Central+Park&where=United+States; a space becomes + and é becomes %E9: artist=Pablo+Jos%E9+Picasso.

الخلاصة

name=value&name=value.
name=value&name=value.

الشريحة 17 — The <form> Element

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Two important attributes that are essential features of any <form> are the action and the method attributes.
  • The action attribute specifies the URL of the server-side resource that will process the form data.
  • The method attribute specifies how the query string data will be transmitted from the browser to the server. There are two possibilities:
    • GET and
    • POST.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Two important attributes that are essential features of any <form> are the action and the method attributes.

    أهم خاصيتين: action و method.

    Two key attributes: action and method.

  2. The action attribute specifies the URL of the server-side resource that will process the form data.

    action: عنوان البرنامج الذي يعالج البيانات.

    action: URL of the program that processes the data.

  3. The method attribute specifies how the query string data will be transmitted from the browser to the server. There are two possibilities: GET and POST.

    method: طريقة الإرسال، GET أو POST.

    method: how data is sent, GET or POST.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

إذا لم تحدد method فالافتراضي GET.

If you omit method, the default is GET.

الخلاصة

action = إلى أين؛ method = كيف.
action = where; method = how.

الشريحة 18 — GET

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • GET
  • Data can be clearly seen in the address bar. This may be an advantage during development but a disadvantage in production.
  • Data remains in browser history and cache. Again this may be beneficial to some users, but it is a security risk on public computers.
  • Data can be bookmarked (also an advantage and a disadvantage).
  • There is a limit on the number of characters in the returned form data.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Data can be clearly seen in the address bar. This may be an advantage during development but a disadvantage in production.

    البيانات ظاهرة في شريط العنوان.

    Data is visible in the address bar.

  2. Data remains in browser history and cache. Again this may be beneficial to some users, but it is a security risk on public computers.

    تبقى في السجل والذاكرة المؤقتة: خطر على الأجهزة العامة.

    Stays in history and cache: risky on public computers.

  3. Data can be bookmarked (also an advantage and a disadvantage).

    يمكن حفظها كمفضلة.

    Can be bookmarked.

  4. There is a limit on the number of characters in the returned form data.

    حد لعدد الأحرف.

    Character limit.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

GET مناسب للبحث والتصفية (يمكن مشاركة الرابط)، لا لكلمات المرور.

GET suits search and filters (the link can be shared), not passwords.

الخلاصة

GET: ظاهر، محفوظ، محدود.
GET: visible, saved, limited.

الشريحة 19 — POST

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • POST
  • Data can contain binary data.
  • Data is hidden from user.
  • Submitted data is not stored in cache, history, or bookmarks.
  • NOTE
  • It should be noted that while the POST method “hides” form data, any user could easily inspect the HTTP header. As a result, the POST method is NOT sufficient from a security standpoint.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Data can contain binary data.

    يقبل بيانات ثنائية (ملفات).

    Can carry binary data (files).

  2. Data is hidden from user.

    مخفي عن المستخدم.

    Hidden from the user.

  3. Submitted data is not stored in cache, history, or bookmarks.

    لا يُحفظ في الذاكرة المؤقتة أو السجل أو المفضلة.

    Not stored in cache, history or bookmarks.

  4. NOTE: It should be noted that while the POST method “hides” form data, any user could easily inspect the HTTP header. As a result, the POST method is NOT sufficient from a security standpoint.

    ملاحظة: POST «يخفي» فقط؛ يمكن فحص الطلب بسهولة، فهو ليس كافيًا أمنيًا.

    Note: POST only “hides”; the request is easy to inspect, so it is NOT enough for security.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الأمان الحقيقي يأتي من HTTPS (تشفير)، لا من POST.

Real security comes from HTTPS (encryption), not POST.

الخلاصة

POST ≠ أمان.
POST ≠ security.

الشريحة 20 — GET vs POST (example)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

[Title only; the content is the figure.]

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<form method="get" action="process.php">
GET /process.php?title=Central+Park&where=United+States http/1.1
                 \_____________ query string _____________/

<form method="post" action="process.php">
POST /process.php http/1.1          \
Date: Sun, 21 May 2017 23:59:59 GMT  |
Host: www.mysite.com                 |  HTTP header
User-Agent: Mozilla/4.0              |
Content-Length: 47                   /

title=Central+Park&where=United+States     <- query string

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. (figure) The same form sent with method="get" (query string in the URL) and with method="post" (query string after the HTTP header)

    نفس النموذج: GET يضع البيانات في الرابط، POST يضعها بعد الترويسة.

    Same form: GET puts data in the URL, POST puts it after the header.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

البيانات نفسها في الحالتين؛ الفرق هو مكانها فقط.

The data is the same in both; only its location differs.

الخلاصة

GET: في الرابط؛ POST: في جسم الطلب.
GET: in the URL; POST: in the body.

الشريحة 21 — Form Control Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

TABLE 5.2 Form-Related HTML Elements (transcribed)
TypeDescription
<button>Defines a clickable button.

    Table 5.2: form elements.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

أكثرها استخدامًا: input (بأنواعه)، select/option، textarea، label، button.

The most used: input (in its types), select/option, textarea, label, button.

الخلاصة

12 عنصرًا.
12 elements.

الشريحة 22 — Text Input Controls

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Most forms need to gather text information from the user. Whether it is a search box or a login form or a user registration form, some type of text input is usually necessary.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<input type="text" ... />
<textarea>
   enter some text
</textarea>
<textarea placeholder="enter some text">
</textarea>
<input type="password" ... />
<input type="search" placeholder="enter search text" ... />
<input type="email" ... />   (Opera: "Please enter a valid email address"; Chrome: "Please enter an email address.")
<input type="url" ... />     ("Please enter a URL.")
<input type="tel" ... />

[The bottom row is cut off at the slide edge.]

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Most forms need to gather text information from the user. Whether it is a search box or a login form or a user registration form, some type of text input is usually necessary.

    معظم النماذج تحتاج إدخال نص: بحث، دخول، تسجيل.

    Most forms need text input: search, login, registration.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

أنواع HTML5 مثل email وurl تتحقق تلقائيًا (رسائل الخطأ في Opera وChrome بالشكل)، وtel يظهر لوحة أرقام على الهاتف.

HTML5 types like email and url validate automatically (error messages in Opera and Chrome in the figure), and tel shows a number pad on phones.

الخلاصة

text، textarea، password، search، email، url، tel.
text, textarea, password, search, email, url, tel.

الشريحة 23 — Choice Controls

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Forms often need the user to select an option from a group of choices. HTML provides several ways to do this.
  • Select Lists
  • Radio Buttons
  • Checkboxes

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Forms often need the user to select an option from a group of choices. HTML provides several ways to do this.

    اختيار من مجموعة خيارات.

    Choosing from a set of options.

  2. Select Lists / Radio Buttons / Checkboxes

    قوائم، أزرار راديو، مربعات اختيار.

    Select lists, radio buttons, checkboxes.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

القائمة توفر المساحة؛ الراديو يظهر كل الخيارات لاختيار واحد؛ المربعات لعدة اختيارات.

A list saves space; radios show every option for one choice; checkboxes for several.

الخلاصة

3 طرق.
3 ways.

الشريحة 24 — Select Lists

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The <select> element is used to create a multiline box for selecting one or more items. The options (defined using the <option> element) can be hidden in a dropdown list or multiple rows of the list can be visible.
  • The selected attribute in the <option> makes it a default value.
  • The value attribute is optional; if it is not specified, then the text within the container is sent instead

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<select name="choices">
   <option>First</option>
   <option>Second</option>
   <option>Third</option>
</select>                          -> ?choices=Second

<select name="choices">
   <option value="1">First</option>
   <option value="2">Second</option>
   <option value="3">Third</option>
</select>                          -> ?choices=2

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The <select> element is used to create a multiline box for selecting one or more items. The options (defined using the <option> element) can be hidden in a dropdown list or multiple rows of the list can be visible.

    <select> لاختيار عنصر أو أكثر؛ الخيارات <option> في قائمة منسدلة أو ظاهرة.

    <select> chooses one or more items; <option>s in a dropdown or visible rows.

  2. The selected attribute in the <option> makes it a default value.

    selected = القيمة الافتراضية.

    selected = the default.

  3. The value attribute is optional; if it is not specified, then the text within the container is sent instead

    value اختياري؛ بدونه يُرسل النص.

    value is optional; without it the text is sent.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لذلك: بدون value يُرسل ?choices=Second، ومع value يُرسل ?choices=2.

So: without value it sends ?choices=Second; with value, ?choices=2.

الخلاصة

value أو النص.
value or the text.

الشريحة 25 — Select Lists (ii)

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Option items can be grouped together via the <optgroup> element.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<select ... >
   <optgroup label="North America">
      <option>Calgary</option>
      <option>Los Angeles</option>
   </optgroup>
   <optgroup label="Europe">
      <option>London</option>
      <option>Paris</option>
      <option>Prague</option>
   </optgroup>
</select>

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Option items can be grouped together via the <optgroup> element.

    <optgroup> يجمع الخيارات.

    <optgroup> groups options.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

عنوان المجموعة (label) يظهر عريضًا ولا يمكن اختياره.

The group label shows in bold and can't be selected.

الخلاصة

optgroup label="…".
optgroup label="…".

الشريحة 26 — Radio Buttons

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Radio buttons are useful when you want the user to select a single item from a small list of choices and you want all the choices to be visible.
  • radio buttons are added via the <input type="radio"> element
  • The checked attribute is used to indicate the default choice, while the value attribute works in the same manner as with the <option> element.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<input type="radio" name="where" value="1">North America<br/>
<input type="radio" name="where" value="2" checked>South America<br/>
<input type="radio" name="where" value="3">Asia

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Radio buttons are useful when you want the user to select a single item from a small list of choices and you want all the choices to be visible.

    الراديو: خيار واحد من قائمة صغيرة ظاهرة كلها.

    Radios: one choice from a small, fully visible list.

  2. radio buttons are added via the <input type="radio"> element

    <input type="radio">.

    <input type="radio">.

  3. The checked attribute is used to indicate the default choice, while the value attribute works in the same manner as with the <option> element.

    checked = الافتراضي؛ value مثل option.

    checked = default; value as with option.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الأزرار تصبح مجموعة واحدة لأنها تحمل نفس name (where)؛ بدون ذلك يمكن اختيار أكثر من واحد.

The buttons form one group because they share the same name (where); otherwise several could be picked.

الخلاصة

نفس name = مجموعة واحدة.
Same name = one group.

الشريحة 27 — Checkboxes

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A checkbox is used for obtaining a yes/no or on/off response from the user.
  • Checkboxes are added via the <input type="checkbox">
  • The checked attribute can be used to set the default value of a checkbox.
  • Each checked checkbox will have its value sent to the server.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

<label>I accept the software license</label>
<input type="checkbox" name="accept" >

<label>Where would you like to visit? </label><br/>
<input type="checkbox" name="visit" value="canada">Canada<br/>
<input type="checkbox" name="visit" value="france">France<br/>
<input type="checkbox" name="visit" value="germany">Germany

-> ?accept=on&visit=canada&visit=germany

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A checkbox is used for obtaining a yes/no or on/off response from the user.

    المربع: نعم/لا.

    Checkbox: yes/no.

  2. Checkboxes are added via the <input type="checkbox">

    <input type="checkbox">.

    <input type="checkbox">.

  3. The checked attribute can be used to set the default value of a checkbox.

    checked = افتراضي.

    checked = default.

  4. Each checked checkbox will have its value sent to the server.

    كل مربع مؤشر تُرسل قيمته.

    Every ticked box sends its value.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

بدون value يُرسل on (accept=on). والمربعات بنفس الاسم تُرسل عدة أزواج: visit=canada&visit=germany.

Without value it sends on (accept=on). Boxes with the same name send several pairs: visit=canada&visit=germany.

الخلاصة

عدة اختيارات.
Multiple choices.

الشريحة 28 — Button Controls

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • <input type="submit"> Creates a button that submits the form data to the server.
  • <input type="reset"> Creates a button that clears any of the user’s already entered form data.
  • <input type="button"> Creates a custom button. This button may require JavaScript for it to actually perform any action.
  • <input type="image"> Creates a custom submit button that uses an image for its display.
  • <button> Creates a custom button.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

TABLE 5.5 HTML5 Date and Time Controls (transcribed)
TypeDescription
dateCreates a general date input control. The format for the date is “yyyy-mm-dd.”

الشريحة 35 — Table and Form Accessibility

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • The W3C created the Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) in 1997 to improve the accessibility of websites. Perhaps the most important guidelines in that document are:
  • Provide text alternatives for any nontext content so that it can be changed into other forms people need, such as large print, braille, speech, symbols, or simpler language.
  • Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example, simpler layout) without losing information or structure.
  • Make all functionality available from a keyboard.
  • Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are
  • The guidelines provide detailed recommendations on how to achieve this advice.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. The W3C created the Web Accessibility Initiative (WAI) in 1997 to improve the accessibility of websites. Perhaps the most important guidelines in that document are:

    W3C أنشأ WAI عام 1997؛ أهم إرشاداته:

    The W3C created WAI in 1997; key guidelines:

  2. Provide text alternatives for any nontext content so that it can be changed into other forms people need, such as large print, braille, speech, symbols, or simpler language.

    بدائل نصية لكل محتوى غير نصي.

    Text alternatives for non-text content.

  3. Create content that can be presented in different ways (for example, simpler layout) without losing information or structure.

    محتوى يُعرض بطرق مختلفة دون فقد.

    Content presentable in different ways without loss.

  4. Make all functionality available from a keyboard.

    كل شيء بلوحة المفاتيح.

    Everything works from a keyboard.

  5. Provide ways to help users navigate, find content, and determine where they are

    مساعدة التنقل ومعرفة المكان.

    Help users navigate and know where they are.

  6. The guidelines provide detailed recommendations on how to achieve this advice.

    الإرشادات تفصل كيف.

    The guidelines detail how.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

هذه الإرشادات هي أساس WCAG.

These guidelines are the basis of WCAG.

الخلاصة

WAI 1997: 4 مبادئ.
WAI 1997: 4 principles.

    scope يربط الخلايا بالعناوين.

scope="col" تعني أن العنوان لعموده؛ scope="row" لصفه. قارئ الشاشة يقرأ «Artist: Jacques-Louis David».

الشريحة 37 — Accessible Forms

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • We already made use of the <fieldset>, <legend>, and <label> elements.
  • Their main purpose is to logically group related form input elements together with the <legend> providing a type of caption for those elements.
  • Each <label> element should be associated with a single input element.
  • You can make this association explicit by using the for attribute so means that if the user clicks on or taps the <label> text the control will receive the focus

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. We already made use of the <fieldset>, <legend>, and <label> elements.

    fieldset وlegend وlabel.

    fieldset, legend and label.

  2. Their main purpose is to logically group related form input elements together with the <legend> providing a type of caption for those elements.

    تجميع الحقول المترابطة، وlegend عنوان المجموعة.

    They group related fields; legend captions the group.

  3. Each <label> element should be associated with a single input element.

    كل label لحقل واحد.

    One label per input.

  4. You can make this association explicit by using the for attribute so means that if the user clicks on or taps the <label> text the control will receive the focus

    الخاصية for تربطها؛ الضغط على النص يركز الحقل.

    The for attribute links them; clicking the text focuses the field.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

for في label = id في الحقل (ليس name).

الخلاصة

for ↔ id.

الشريحة 39 — Styling Form Elements

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Perhaps the first and most important rule is to style your form elements so they look different from the default settings.
  • Let’s begin with the common text and button controls. A common styling change is to eliminate the borders and add in rounded corners and padding.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

/* text inputs */
border: 0;
margin: 3px;
padding: 7px 5px;
border-radius: 2px;

::placeholder { color: #D9E2EC; }
... border-bottom: 1px solid;

/* primary button "Click" */
border: 0;
margin: 4px;
padding: 5px;
color: white;
width: 100px;
cursor: pointer;
border-radius: 2px;
background-color: #003E6B;

/* secondary buttons */
...
border-radius: 5px;
background-color: #F0F4F8;
color: #003E6B;
border: solid 1pt #9FB3C8;
box-shadow: 4px 4px 8px rgba(159,179,200,.7);

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Perhaps the first and most important rule is to style your form elements so they look different from the default settings.

    أول قاعدة: لا تترك الشكل الافتراضي.

    Rule one: don't leave the default look.

  2. Let’s begin with the common text and button controls. A common styling change is to eliminate the borders and add in rounded corners and padding.

    إزالة الحدود وإضافة زوايا مستديرة وحشو.

    Remove borders, add rounded corners and padding.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

الشكل يقارن «Default control appearance» بـ «Customized controls»: زر أساسي داكن (#003E6B) وأزرار ثانوية فاتحة بظل.

The figure compares “Default control appearance” with “Customized controls”: a dark primary button (#003E6B) and light secondary buttons with a shadow.

الشريحة 40 — Working with labels

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • By default, form elements are inline-block elements (have padding and margin) but sit on the same line. Labels, however, are inline.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

/* Multiple controls on single line */
<label for="title">Title</label>
<input type="text" name="title" id="title"/>
<label for="year">Year</label>
<input type="text" name="year" id="year" />

/* Each label and control pair on single line:
   Requires CSS layout techniques, such as grid, flex, floats, or positioning. Covered in Chapter 7. */

/* Vertical */
label {
   display: block;
   margin: 10px 0 0 5px;
}

/* Vertical, but no labels */
<input type="text" name="title" placeholder="Title" />
<input type="text" name="year" placeholder="Year" />

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. By default, form elements are inline-block elements (have padding and margin) but sit on the same line. Labels, however, are inline.

    عناصر النموذج inline-block؛ label عنصر inline.

    Form controls are inline-block; labels are inline.

  2. (figure) “So, which design is pereferable?” — Multiple controls on single line / Each label and control pair on single line / Vertical / Vertical, but no labels

    أي تصميم أفضل؟ أربعة تخطيطات.

    Which design is better? Four layouts.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

التخطيط العمودي (label { display: block }) أسهل قراءة غالبًا. «بدون labels» يعتمد على placeholder، وهو أضعف للإتاحة لأن النص يختفي عند الكتابة. (كلمة pereferable خطأ مطبعي في الشريحة.)

The vertical layout (label { display: block }) is usually easiest to read. “No labels” relies on placeholder, weaker for accessibility because the text vanishes when typing. (“pereferable” is a typo on the slide.)

الخلاصة

display: block للـ label.
display: block on labels.

الشريحة 41 — Form Design

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • A well-designed form communicates to a user that the site values their time and data.
  • Figure 5.33 describes and illustrates a small set of straightforward additional precepts

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

المصدر — النص داخل الصورة

Figure 5.33 call-outs (transcribed)
Precept
Use a background color to add contrast between input controls and rest of page.
Group related items in visually distinct sections.
Use placeholders to indicate input format.
Buttons should be used for actions.
Use borders to separate sections.
Add white space within form controls by increasing height and adding padding.
Add space above labels to make it clear to which control the label is connected.
Indicate which control has focus.
Style select lists, checkboxes, and radio buttons differently from the default look.
Use size, typography, and color to emphasize/deemphasize relative importance of information or controls.
The primary action button should be clearly indicated with the largest visual contrast on form.
Secondary buttons should be less prominant with lower contrast or as outlines. [sic]

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. A well-designed form communicates to a user that the site values their time and data.

    النموذج الجيد يحترم وقت المستخدم.

    A good form respects the user's time.

  2. Figure 5.33 describes and illustrates a small set of straightforward additional precepts

    الشكل 5.33: قواعد إضافية.

    Figure 5.33: extra precepts.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

أهمها: زر أساسي واحد واضح، وإظهار الحقل الذي عليه التركيز.

الشريحة 42 — Validating User Input

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • User input must never be trusted.
  • It could be missing.
  • It might be in the wrong format.
  • It might even contain JavaScript or SQL as a means to causing some type of havoc.
  • Thus, almost always user input must be tested for validity.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. User input must never be trusted.

    لا تثق أبدًا بمدخلات المستخدم.

    Never trust user input.

  2. It could be missing.

    قد تكون ناقصة.

    It may be missing.

  3. It might be in the wrong format.

    بصيغة خاطئة.

    Wrong format.

  4. It might even contain JavaScript or SQL as a means to causing some type of havoc.

    قد تحتوي JavaScript أو SQL للهجوم.

    May contain JavaScript or SQL to attack.

  5. Thus, almost always user input must be tested for validity.

    لذا تحقق دائمًا.

    So always validate.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

هذا يربط الويب بأمن المعلومات: حقن SQL وXSS يبدآن من مدخلات غير متحقق منها.

This links web dev to security: SQL injection and XSS start with unvalidated input.

الخلاصة

لا ثقة.
Zero trust.

الشريحة 43 — Types of Input Validation

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Required information. Some data fields just cannot be left empty.
  • Correct data type. Some fields such as numbers or dates, must follow the rules for its data type in order to be considered valid.
  • Correct format. Some information, such as postal codes, credit card numbers, and social security numbers have to follow certain pattern rules.
  • Comparison. Some user-entered fields are considered correct or not in relation to an already inputted value (password confirm)
  • Range check.
  • Custom.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Required information. Some data fields just cannot be left empty.

    مطلوب: لا يُترك فارغًا.

    Required: can't be empty.

  2. Correct data type. Some fields such as numbers or dates, must follow the rules for its data type in order to be considered valid.

    نوع البيانات: رقم، تاريخ.

    Data type: number, date.

  3. Correct format. Some information, such as postal codes, credit card numbers, and social security numbers have to follow certain pattern rules.

    الصيغة: رمز بريدي، بطاقة.

    Format: postal code, card.

  4. Comparison. Some user-entered fields are considered correct or not in relation to an already inputted value (password confirm)

    مقارنة: تأكيد كلمة المرور.

    Comparison: password confirm.

  5. Range check.

    المدى.

    Range check.

  6. Custom.

    مخصص.

    Custom.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

مثال المدى: السنة بين 500 و2014 (الشريحة 45). مخصص: مثل التحقق من أن اسم المستخدم غير مأخوذ.

Range example: year between 500 and 2014 (slide 45). Custom: e.g. checking a username isn't taken.

الخلاصة

6 أنواع.
6 types.

الشريحة 44 — Notifying the User

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • What is the problem? Users do not want to read lengthy messages to determine what needs to be changed.
  • Where is the problem? Some type of error indication should be located near the field that generated the problem.
  • If appropriate, how do I fix it? For instance, don’t just tell the user that a date is in the wrong format; tell him or her what format you are expecting

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. What is the problem? Users do not want to read lengthy messages to determine what needs to be changed.

    ما المشكلة؟ رسالة قصيرة.

    What's wrong? A short message.

  2. Where is the problem? Some type of error indication should be located near the field that generated the problem.

    أين؟ بجانب الحقل.

    Where? Next to the field.

  3. If appropriate, how do I fix it? For instance, don’t just tell the user that a date is in the wrong format; tell him or her what format you are expecting

    كيف أصلحها؟ اذكر الصيغة المتوقعة.

    How to fix? State the expected format.

الشريحة 46 — How to Reduce Validation Errors

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Provide textual hints to the user on the form itself (last slide)
  • Using tool tips or pop-overs to display context-sensitive help about the expected input
  • Another technique for helping the user understand the correct format for an input field is to provide a JavaScript-based mask
  • Providing sensible default values for text fields can reduce validation errors
  • Finally, many user input errors can be eliminated by choosing a better data entry type than the standard <input type="text">.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  2. Using tool tips or pop-overs to display context-sensitive help about the expected input

  3. Another technique for helping the user understand the correct format for an input field is to provide a JavaScript-based mask

  4. Providing sensible default values for text fields can reduce validation errors

    قيم افتراضية معقولة.

  5. Finally, many user input errors can be eliminated by choosing a better data entry type than the standard <input type="text">.

الشريحة 47 — Where to Perform Validation

المصدر — المحتوى الأصلي

  • Validation can be performed at three different levels.
  • With HTML5, the browser can perform basic validation.
  • JavaScript validation dramatically improves the user experience of data-entry forms, and is an essential feature of any real-world web site that uses forms. Unfortunately, JavaScript validation cannot be relied on.
  • server-side validation is arguably the most important since it is the only validation that is guaranteed to run.

Footer: Pearson — Copyright © 2021, 2018, 2015 Pearson Education, Inc. All Rights Reserved

الشرح — جملة بجملة

  1. Validation can be performed at three different levels.

    ثلاثة مستويات.

    Three levels.

  2. With HTML5, the browser can perform basic validation.

    HTML5: المتصفح.

    HTML5: the browser.

  3. JavaScript validation dramatically improves the user experience of data-entry forms, and is an essential feature of any real-world web site that uses forms. Unfortunately, JavaScript validation cannot be relied on.

    JavaScript: تجربة أفضل لكن لا يُعتمد عليه.

    JavaScript: better UX but can't be relied on.

  4. server-side validation is arguably the most important since it is the only validation that is guaranteed to run.

    الخادم: الأهم، الوحيد المضمون.

    Server: most important, the only one guaranteed to run.

الشرح — شرح موسّع

لماذا؟ المستخدم يستطيع تعطيل JavaScript أو إرسال طلب مباشرة بدون المتصفح.

Why? A user can disable JavaScript or send a request directly without the browser.

الخلاصة

الخادم دائمًا.
Always the server.

05 ثلاثة مستويات

  • الجدول مثل جدول الحصص: صفوف وخلايا.
  • النموذج مثل استمارة ورقية تسلمها لموظف (الخادم).
  • GET مثل بطاقة بريدية: الكل يقرأ ما عليها. POST مثل ظرف: مغلق لكن يمكن فتحه.
  • الراديو مثل اختيار إجابة واحدة؛ المربعات مثل «اختر كل ما ينطبق».
  • لا تصدق كل ما يكتبه الناس: تحقق دائمًا.
  • A table is like a class timetable: rows and cells.
  • A form is like a paper form you hand to a clerk (the server).
  • GET is a postcard: anyone can read it. POST is an envelope: closed, but it can be opened.
  • Radios are pick-one; checkboxes are “select all that apply”.
  • Don't believe everything people type: always check.
  • الجدول: table/tr/td/th، colspan/rowspan، caption، colgroup/col، thead/tfoot/tbody؛ CSS: border على table وtd، border-collapse، border-spacing، :hover، :nth-child.
  • النموذج: action (URL المعالج)، method (GET افتراضي/POST)، enctype للملفات؛ البيانات name=value&… مرمزة URL.
  • GET: في سطر الطلب، يظهر في السجل والمفضلة، محدود. POST: في الجسم بعد الترويسة، يدعم الثنائي، ليس آمنًا بدون HTTPS.
  • العناصر: input (text، password، search، email، url، tel، radio، checkbox، submit، reset، button، image، hidden، file، number، range، color، date…)، select/option/optgroup، textarea، button، label، fieldset/legend.
  • الإتاحة: WAI، caption، scope، label for=id. التحقق: 6 أنواع، 3 مستويات، الخادم إلزامي.
  • Tables: table/tr/td/th, colspan/rowspan, caption, colgroup/col, thead/tfoot/tbody; CSS: borders on table and td, border-collapse, border-spacing, :hover, :nth-child.
  • Forms: action (handler URL), method (GET default/POST), enctype for files; data is name=value&… URL encoded.
  • GET: in the request line, shows in history and bookmarks, limited. POST: in the body after the header, supports binary, not secure without HTTPS.
  • Controls: input (text, password, search, email, url, tel, radio, checkbox, submit, reset, button, image, hidden, file, number, range, color, date…), select/option/optgroup, textarea, button, label, fieldset/legend.
  • Accessibility: WAI, caption, scope, label for=id. Validation: 6 types, 3 levels, server mandatory.
  • table ← tr ← td/th.
  • colspan أعمدة، rowspan صفوف.
  • tfoot قبل tbody.
  • border على table وtd فقط.
  • collapse = حد مشترك.
  • name=value&… ، المسافة + ، é = %E9.
  • GET رابط؛ POST جسم.
  • value غائب ← النص يُرسل.
  • checkbox بدون value ← on.
  • ملف ← post + multipart/form-data.
  • label for = id.
  • scope="col".
  • الخادم دائمًا.
  • table → tr → td/th.
  • colspan columns, rowspan rows.
  • tfoot before tbody.
  • Borders on table and td only.
  • collapse = shared border.
  • name=value&…, space +, é = %E9.
  • GET URL; POST body.
  • No value → text is sent.
  • Checkbox without value → on.
  • File → post + multipart/form-data.
  • label for = id.
  • scope="col".
  • Always the server.

06 اختبار تفاعلي

النتيجة 0/30

    07 نصائح احترافية

    كيف تفهم بدل أن تحفظ

    • ارسم الجدول على ورق أولًا وعد الخلايا في كل صف؛ كل colspan يحسب أكثر من خلية.
    • أرسل نموذجًا بـ GET وانظر شريط العنوان: هذا هو سلسلة الاستعلام.
    • افتح أدوات المطور ← Network وأرسل بـ POST لترى البيانات في الطلب، وستفهم لماذا POST ليس أمانًا.
    • اسأل لكل حقل: ماذا لو أرسل المستخدم شيئًا خاطئًا؟
    • Sketch the table on paper first and count the cells per row; each colspan counts as more than one.
    • Submit a form with GET and look at the address bar: that's the query string.
    • Open dev tools → Network and submit with POST to see the data in the request, and you'll see why POST isn't security.
    • For each field ask: what if the user sends something wrong?

    تمارين عملية مقترحة

    1. ابن جدول اللوحات في الشريحة 7 بكل عناصره.
    2. نسقه بأسلوب الصناديق والحمار الوحشي (11–12).
    3. ابن نموذج الشريحة 14 مع label for وأرسله بـ GET ثم POST.
    4. أضف رفع ملف وحقول number وdate.
    5. اكتب رسائل خطأ تجيب ماذا/أين/كيف.
    1. Build slide 7's paintings table with every element.
    2. Style it with boxes and zebras (11–12).
    3. Build slide 14's form with label for, and send it with GET then POST.
    4. Add a file upload and number and date fields.
    5. Write error messages that answer what/where/how.

    أخطاء شائعة

    • عدد خلايا مختلف بين الصفوف.
    • استخدام الجداول للتخطيط.
    • وضع حدود على tr وتوقع ظهورها.
    • نسيان name فلا يُرسل الحقل.
    • أسماء مختلفة لأزرار الراديو في نفس المجموعة.
    • رفع ملف بـ GET أو بدون enctype.
    • ربط label for بالـ name بدل id.
    • الاعتماد على JavaScript وحده للتحقق.
    • الظن أن POST يشفر البيانات.
    • Different cell counts across rows.
    • Using tables for layout.
    • Putting borders on tr and expecting them to show.
    • Forgetting name, so the field isn't sent.
    • Different names for radios in one group.
    • Uploading a file with GET or without enctype.
    • Pointing label for at the name instead of the id.
    • Relying on JavaScript alone for validation.
    • Thinking POST encrypts data.
